Puts a texture on the whole entity, replacing the one of its mesh. `frame` picks the frame of an animated texture and `index` picks the layer for multitexturing, 0 to 7, see `TextureBlend`. Textures made with [CreateTexture](CreateTexture) or [LoadTexture](LoadTexture) can be shared between any number of entities.

```blitzbasic
;media still blitz3d/entitytexture.png
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
PositionEntity camera, 0, 0, -4
light = CreateLight()
RotateEntity light, 45, 45, 0
tex = CreateTexture(64, 64, 1 + 4096)
SetBuffer TextureBuffer(tex)
For y = 0 To 7
	For x = 0 To 7
		If (x + y) Mod 2 = 0 Then Color 240, 240, 240 Else Color 40, 90, 200
		Rect x * 8, y * 8, 8, 8, 1
	Next
Next
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
cube = CreateCube()
TurnEntity cube, 25, 35, 0
EntityTexture cube, tex
RenderWorld
Flip
WaitKey
```

![EntityTexture](media/blitz3d/entitytexture.png)
@param entity   Entity handle.
@param texture  Texture handle.
@param frame    Frame of an animated texture. Defaults to 0.
@param index    Texture layer, 0 to 7. Defaults to 0.
@gap A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the texture is not 0 and does not exist, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
